label: Unsolved Mystery

szenen.text: In 1977, a telescope heard *something* from space.
It was Ohio State's *Big Ear* radio telescope.
It was about *30 times* louder than background noise.
An astronomer circled it and wrote: *'Wow!'*
It came from the direction of *Sagittarius.*
We don't know what it was. *Aliens? Natural?*
Nobody knows. What do *you* think? Follow for more.

caption: A 72-second radio signal from space in 1977 was never explained. Aliens or natural cause? AI voice & edit. Footage: Pixabay/Pexels.
